messages:
olivia: Need a standard proxy->admission fingerprint header for abuse detection. Keep it minimal, versioned, and privacy-safe. Thoughts?

kevin: Edge compute gives richer signals but ops for keys/certs is real. Must version and fallback.

josh: Proposal (single header): `X-RD-FP: v=1;id=sha256(client_entropy||region_salt);ip_h=sha256(ip||salt_v1);ua_h=sha256(ua||salt);sig=hmac_v1(...)`  signature to detect tampering.

maria: Privacy constraints: never send raw IP/UA, use per-region salts rotated daily, retention default 30d, opt-out for customers. Telemetry must store only salted hashes.

kevin: Fallback: unknown version or bad sig -> increment `fp_invalid` and treat request as `unattributed` (apply conservative soft-shed rather than hard reject).

olivia: Telemetry we want: `fp_invalid_rate`, `fp_unknown_ratio`, `rejections_per_k_by_fp`, and `fp_verification_latency`. Alerts on spikes.

rate-bot: feature-flag created: `ff/ingress-fp` in staging.

josh: I'll produce a short RFC + header tests and a tiny sampling plan (1/100) to validate signals. Will include proto and migration notes.

maria: I'll coordinate legal/privacy for sampling and retention.

olivia: Great. Keep the header minimal and versioned so we can iterate without breaking clients. Thanks all.
